cases.title: Two materials on one surface
cases.story: A second PhysicalMaterial was pasted into the same Appearance.
cases.harm: A browser keeps one material and silently drops the other. Which one depends on the browser.

cases.title: Two geometries in one Shape
cases.story: A Sphere was added beside the Box inside one Shape.
cases.harm: Shape.geometry holds one node. One of the two is never drawn.

cases.title: Longitude written first (Angkor)
cases.story: The comparison viewpoint was typed longitude, latitude.
cases.harm: Latitude 103.867 does not exist. A viewer puts the camera somewhere undefined.

cases.title: Longitude written first (Giza)
cases.story: The same slip, at a site where both numbers are under 90.
cases.harm: The camera lands about 230 km away, in the Sinai. No range test can see this one.

cases.title: Shaft stretched by a scale
cases.story: Someone scaled Shaft A to 'look right'. The Box still says 9.62 m.
cases.harm: The drawing shows 12.5 m; the excavation report says 9.62 m.

cases.title: Shaft redrawn as a Cylinder
cases.story: The Box was swapped for a Cylinder 12 m tall.
cases.harm: The record's measurement no longer has anything it can be compared with.

cases.title: A tunnel nobody recorded
cases.story: A 90 m tunnel was drawn under the plateau with no record behind it.
cases.harm: A reader takes a drawn object for a documented one.

cases.title: Depth recorded in feet
cases.story: The record's unit for Shaft A was changed to feet; the number stayed 9.62.
cases.harm: 9.62 ft is 2.93 m. The scene and the record now disagree by a factor of 3.28 and both look fine alone.

cases.title: A speculative claim loses its label
cases.story: The Hall of Records attribution no longer assigns a tier.
cases.harm: The one speculative element in the scene is drawn like the documented ones.

cases.title: The record points at nothing
cases.story: The record names a scene node that does not exist.
cases.harm: A measurement exists on paper and can never be checked against the drawing.
